title: THE COGNITION ANNALS
lede: An unauthorized, over-decorated, fully static record of Cognition — the lab that went from three IOI gold medalists in a San Francisco living room to the company behind Devin, Windsurf, and the SWE model line. Every page on this node was compiled by dogbed: knap template in, textile through the middle, HTML out. No CMS. No JavaScript. No edit button.

h2. WHAT IS THIS NODE

p. This is a museum built out of plain text. Somewhere upstream there is a file called @page.knap@, a pile of JSON objects, and a single Zig binary named %(amber)dogbed%. The binary chewed the templates, spat out Textile, pushed it through oliver, and soldered the result into the document you are reading. The entire site — the scanlines, the ticker, the bezel — is one stylesheet and zero lines of JavaScript.

p. The subject matter deserves the treatment. In under three years, %(ok)Cognition% went from unveiling a demo of "the first AI software engineer" to training reinforcement-learning models at multi-trillion-parameter scale, rescuing an orphaned IDE in a weekend, and shipping a coding model that sits within a point of the frontier at a fraction of the cost. These are the annals of that run.
